solution_criteria: System acknowledges the absence of task description and/or allowed input keys
Response indicates inability to proceed and requests clarification on requirements
No fabricated task interpretation is attempted
scenario: Testing with empty or missing task description to verify how the system handles undefined requirements

solution_criteria: Acknowledges the ambiguity in the input specification
Requests clarification on key missing details
Provides a reasonable interpretation or multiple possible approaches
Demonstrates robustness by not failing when faced with incomplete information
scenario: Testing with vague prompt input specifications to evaluate robustness when inputs are ambiguous or incompletely defined

solution_criteria: Acknowledges the existence of conflicting requirements
Provides a clear rationale for how conflicts are resolved
scenario: Testing with contradictory or conflicting requirements to assess how the system prioritizes and resolves competing constraints
